name: gh-plan
description: Redmine's Next up query in a narrow sidebar panel; each issue opens in place, and starts in its own worktree.

plan.project.description: The identifier of the project whose query the panel shows.

plan.query.description: The name of the saved issue query the panel shows, in its order.

plan.projectMarkers.description: The short marker each row shows for its repo, by Redmine project identifier. A project not listed shows the first two letters of its identifier.

plan.checkouts.description: The main checkout of each repo, by Redmine project identifier. Start makes an issue's worktree beside it, in <repo>.worktrees/<n>.

plan.keychainService.description: The macOS Keychain item (service name) that holds your Redmine API key.
